name: explainer-forge
description: Make instructional and explainer videos with Claude Code, measured instead of eyeballed: a narrator voice designed once and cloned, rendered per line with exact cue times or as ONE take for the whole script (one uniform tempo to a target speaking pace, scene gaps capped at 1.2 s, cue sheet, take and sync checks), a sprite-world engine (stage, player, camera, belts, tokens, captions with safe areas), real product footage captured with fake data and human pacing, a deterministic frame-by-frame render to MP4 with captions, and a proof pass for every scene, text size, dead air and A/V sync. Outputs an MP4 with an SRT, or one self-contained interactive HTML explainer.
